Hi! I’m interested in purchasing either the Harlo B30 or the Magic Miner 40T, with delivery to Madrid, Spain.

If you can offer an earlier shipping date than the batches currently listed on your website, I’m ready to place and pay for the order immediately.

Do you have any units available from cancellations, an earlier batch, or another warehouse?

Please let me know which model could ship soonest, the expected dispatch and delivery dates, and the total cost including shipping and any applicable taxes.

Thank you!

JM G., M.D.,Phd
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

Hi Jose M.,

Good to hear from you, and glad the KBOX finally landed in Madrid on October 3.

I checked all three warehouses before answering, so this is the real picture. Neither model has a free unit on the shelf in the US, Canada or the Netherlands, so there is nothing from a cancellation or an earlier batch I can allocate to you, and I won't promise a date I can't hold.

Soonest is the Harlo B30 at $899, 30 TH/s, which ships November 30, 2026. The Magic Miner 40T at $799 is now on Batch 8 and ships December 7, 2026. If speed is what decides it, the B30 is your unit by one week; if value per terahash matters more, the 40T gives you 40 TH/s for $100 less, a week later. You can follow both shipments on their way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

On cost, one correction in your favour from what I told you in September. Orders to Spain ship from our Rotterdam warehouse, with the EU plug, so import VAT is included in the price and there is nothing for the carrier or customs to collect on delivery. Shipping is the only extra and it's calculated from your address at checkout. From Rotterdam to Madrid is a short run, a few business days after dispatch.

If you want to lock a slot in these batches, these take you straight to checkout: B30 https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/48819425706239:1 and Magic Miner 40T https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/48890366853375:1

Tell me which one you prefer and I'll keep an eye on the order myself.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Thank S!!! I will buy the magic miner are the end of month.   I will let you know !!  By the way the ac cable in the kbox was the us conector.  When i hay the magic miner, i hope they send me the right Eu cable 🙏🙏
JM G., M.D.,Phd
Searched the catalog · EU power cord cable IEC C13
Handed to the team · Wrong plug shipped on a fulfilled drop-ship order; I cannot send a part myself (

Hi Jose M.,

Sorry about that cable. The K. ships direct from GekkoScience in the US, which is how a US cord ended up in your box. That is a packing error on our side of the deal, not yours, so nothing goes back and no return is needed. A colleague is picking it up today to get an EU cord out to you.

On the Magic Miner 40T, orders to Spain go out from our Rotterdam warehouse, so it travels with the European cord as standard rather than coming from the US. I have also put the EU cord requirement on your file, so when you place the order at the end of the month it is already noted against it.

One thing to keep in mind for timing. The 40T is on Batch 8 with a ship date of December 7, 2026, and batches fill up, so ordering later in the month means a later batch if that one closes. If you would rather hold a place in Batch 8, the link is https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/48890366853375:1 and you can follow the shipment on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Just reply here when you are ready and I will keep an eye on the order myself.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Order complete. !!!  Please make sure you and the right ac power cable according to european standard plug. In the last order ( kbox) you send me the standar us cable 🙏

JM G., M.D.,Phd

Hi Jose M.,

Order Shop···· is in, paid, $819.00, with the Magic Miner 40T from Batch 8 and the Harlo OS Diagnostics plus 3 month RMA cover.

On the cable, I have written the requirement onto the order itself and tagged it, so the warehouse sees it at pick and pack: European Schuko cord, not US. Your unit goes out of our Rotterdam warehouse because it is shipping to Spain, and that warehouse packs the European cord as standard, so the note is a belt and braces on top of that. What happened with the KBOX was different, that one shipped direct from GekkoScience in the US and came out of their box with their cord.

Your shipping is Standard with customs and duties prepaid, so nothing is collected from you on delivery in Madrid. Batch 8 ships December 7, 2026, and you can watch the shipment on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The E. cord for the KBOX is already with the team and they pick that up Monday at 10am ET, with the answer coming to your email, so you do not need to chase it.

Thanks for coming back to us, and enjoy the 40T.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
